sessions.title: Hinge + Upper Balance
sessions.goal: Open the 5-day block clean. Re-groove trap bar hinge, balanced push/pull, bilateral squat pattern.
sessions.success: Trap bar identical reps with free back. Upper work controlled. Leave 2–3 in the tank.
sessions.note: Last hard data 7 Sep: trap 60×5×4 @6.5; incline 17.5; rows ~15; goblet 15; farmers 20. Back stiff then — longer warm-up earns the session.

sessions.note: 7 Sep: purple-band pull-ups 6/6/6 felt good. Prefer reverse lunge over goblet if warm-up check is clean.
